'''''Cargo Port Blueprint''''' was a poster available in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] at some point after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It depicted a blueprint of a [[Hangar/Legends|cargo port]]. The [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]] lettering at the top of the poster read "Cargo Port".<ref name="SWG" />

==Behind the scenes==
''Cargo Port Blueprint'' is a poster that appeared in the the [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online roleplaying video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']],<ref name="SWG" /> which was released on [[June 26]], [[2003]]<ref name="Start">{{SWArchive|url=gaming/videogames/news/news20030617.html|text=''Galaxies'' to Release June 26}}</ref> and shut down on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> It could be used in the player's home as decoration. It was made by collecting all the parts for the "viewscreen printer" item which could be looted from various enemies in the game. When all were collected and combined, it would produce one of three random paintings, the others being ''[[Coronet Skyscraper Blueprint]]'' and [[Freedom (painting)|''Freedom'']]. With the introduction of the ''New Game Enhancements'' in [[2005]], several items required for the viewscreen printer were made unobtainable, making these paintings valuable collectors items within the game. However, this poster in particular was still available as loot from enemies, making it less valuable than the others.<ref name="SWG" />
